diagnosis: The customer missed the 7-day manual replay window due to a two-week outage. Per policy, no escalation is required as the entitlement limits are clear and no exception can be made.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. According to our webhook delivery policy, failed events are available for manual replay for seven days after the final retry attempt. Since your outage lasted two weeks, the events from that period are no longer available for replay. You can find more details in our article on webhook delivery failures and replay.
